title: Field rules
description: field/rules.yaml of the game pack: player movement and partner following (game/field, docs/reference/campo.md). Distances in world units (100 = one collision cell), speeds per second, turn speeds in radians per second.

run_distance.description: In partner radii: beyond it runs.

walk_distance.description: In partner radii: beyond it walks, closer it stops.

spawn_distance.description: Distance from the player when entering a map.

trail_length.description: Most player cells remembered while the partner cannot see the player.

sight_half_width.description: Half width of the corridor that must be free to see the player.

stuck_seconds.description: Time without progress before the partner is placed behind the player.

teleport_distance.description: Farther than this, the partner is placed behind the player.

dead_zone.description: Stick vectors shorter than this are no movement.

arrive_distance.description: Click-to-move: stopped by a wall this close to the clicked point counts as arrived.

transition.description: The map change: the screen fades out while the player walks on, then fades in before it can move (tamer.c: tamerTickChangeMap).

frame_seconds.description: One frame of the original: the fade steps once per frame.

fade_out_frames.description: The fade out's frame on which the new map loads (fade.c: fadeToBlack).

fade_in_frames.description: The fade in's frame on which the player moves again (fade.c: fadeFromBlack).

shade_step.description: How much the subtracted grey rises or falls per frame (fade.c: renderFadeOut, renderFadeIn).

shade_full.description: The grey from which the screen is black: the fade's white texel times grey / 128.

name_frame.description: The fade out's frame on which the new map's name appears (map.c: addMapNameObject).

script_motion.description: The story's scripted moves (script_interp.c: tickScriptedMovement). Optional.

look_turn_speed.description: How fast entity_look_at_entity turns a character, radians a second (overworld.c: rotateEntity, 0x200 of 4096 a frame).

time_of_day.description: The times of day (map.c: updateTimeOfDay): the hour each starts at, the only hours the background palette fades at, and the scale of the map lights at dusk and at night, as red, green and blue.

npc.description: How the map's NPCs move and touch (overworld.c: NPCEntityTickOverworld; map.c: entityCheckCollision, collisionGrace). Optional: without it, the original's values.

walk_speed.description: Ground speed of the walk animation.

run_speed.description: Ground speed of the run animation.

turn_speed.description: How fast it turns toward its waypoint.

grace_turn_speed.description: How fast a blocked NPC turns toward a free side.

stuck_turn_speed.description: How fast a blocked NPC with no free side turns.

talk_reach.description: How much further the player reaches the way it faces when confirm is pressed while standing.

tracking.description: How the NPCs see the player and go after it, by their record's follow mode (overworld.c: NPCEntityTickOverworld). Optional: without it, the NPCs never see the player.

radius_tenths.description: The radius test's radius: trackingRange * radius_tenths / 10.

chase_wait_frames.description: Frames a chasing NPC waits where it saw the player.

follow_wait_frames.description: Frames a following NPC waits back home.

modes.description: The reaction of the NPCs with each follow mode; a mode not listed does not react.

spot.description: rect: within trackingRange of its home on both axes; radius: the radius test.

reaction.description: look: stand and turn to the player; chase: run where it saw the player, wait and walk home; follow: go after the player while it is in the radius, then home.

light.description: Scale of each light's red, green and blue.

model.description: Asset id of the .glb drawn for it.

radius.description: Collision size: the probe reaches radius ahead and radius / 2 to the sides.

turn_speed.description: How fast the facing turns; 0 = at once.
